target.title: fix(qa): reuse one package across smoke Docker lanes
target.body:
Related: #99705
Related: #99368

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes the new QA Smoke CI regression where the required job grew from roughly 5–6 minutes to 11–13 minutes and began failing with Node heap exhaustion after smoke-linked scenarios moved to primary Docker runtime evidence.

The two Docker scenarios each called the package helper independently after the gateway scenarios completed. That serialized two full OpenClaw builds, and either build could exhaust the previous 8 GB heap under CI contention.

## Why This Change Was Made

Keep the primary Docker coverage introduced by #99705, but prepare the candidate OpenClaw tarball once before the profile runs and expose it through the existing `OPENCLAW_CURRENT_PACKAGE_TGZ` Docker E2E contract.

All six release-category scenarios remain on Docker. Taxonomy category IDs remain the single source of truth for profile selection; this does not add a profile allowlist or move smoke evidence back to focused Vitest tests.

The package build receives a 12 GB Node heap because the observed `tsdown` failures approached the previous 8 GB ceiling. Each Docker scenario mounts the same validated tarball instead of rebuilding the distribution.

## User Impact

Contributors retain the stronger packaged-runtime coverage without paying for duplicate package builds or hitting the observed 8 GB build OOM. The full remote smoke command completed in 5m07s with the shared package, including 1m32s package preparation and 2m57s profile execution.

## Evidence

- Before regression: sampled June 26 QA Smoke jobs completed in approximately 4m40s–6m27s.
- After #99705/#99736: sampled July 4 jobs took approximately 10m22s–13m33s.
- Failed July 4 artifacts showed both newly selected Docker scenarios invoking their own package build and failing in `tsdown` near the 8 GB heap ceiling.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/ci-workflow-guards.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/scenario-catalog.test.ts` — 66/66 passed.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/e2e/qa-lab/runtime/package-openclaw-for-docker.e2e.test.ts test/e2e/qa-lab/runtime/docker-e2e-lane.fixture.test.ts` — 24/24 passed.
- `pnpm format:check ...` for all touched files — passed.
- Full remote `smoke-ci` profile with both Docker scenarios — passed; shared package 1m32s, profile 2m57s, full command 5m07s.
  - Blacksmith Testbox-through-Crabbox: `tbx_01kwnj0ja36rjm5r9gyah51xbj`
  - Actions run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28693254338
- Structured Codex autoreview — no accepted/actionable findings; patch correct at 0.88 confidence.
